verdict.rationale: YYLO documents `yy continue SESSION_ID` for continuing a captured agent session without reconstructing work, and workflow steps can reuse a session from an earlier step. This supports follow-up turns on an existing session, but nothing shows injecting instructions into a session while it is still running. missing for 10: evidence of live mid-run steering of an active session, documentation of how follow-up prompts are passed to `yy continue`, independent or hands-on corroboration.
